comparison.objective: Sets two weld-neck flanges on riser stubs and two-holes them to plant centrelines; candidate removes HELICOIL tangs.
comparison.physical_skill: Flange placement and angular alignment differ from bimanual mandrel stabilization, impact regulation, and millimetre-scale fragment retrieval.
comparison.success_condition: Flanges must be seated and rotationally aligned; candidate requires four fractures, four recovered tangs, retained inserts, no damage, and stable tool release.
comparison.reason: Shared alignment is generic; flange clocking does not test impact-driven notch fracture or fragment containment.
